tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description:
Search restaurants in Lanzarote that publish their menu through Aventurator Gastro (digital, multilingual QR menus). This is a directory lookup only — restaurants are visited in person, there is no ordering or booking through this tool.

Args:
  - query (string, optional): free-text match against re

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.description:
Get the full digital menu for one restaurant by slug (from search_restaurants), in a given language. Falls back to the restaurant's default language if the requested one isn't published yet.

Args:
  - slug (string, required): restaurant slug, e.g. "slainte-irish-pub"
  - language (string, optional)
